versions.changelog:
Initial release of the element-ui-docs skill:

- Provides full Chinese documentation for Element UI (Vue 2.x), including all 61 components and 5 guides.
- Covers API reference, copy-ready code examples, design principles, and quickstart instructions.
- Lists when and how to trigger this skill, including search tips for frequent usage scenarios.
- Includes best practices and safety notes for forms, uploads, and global methods.
- Breaks reference docs into 66 small files for efficient, on-demand lookup.
